content:
maya: Heads-up: we had a spike of invoke.validation errors hitting tool-invoke in eu-west at ~04:10 UTC. ~12% fell back to degen models and cost spiked.
liam: saw the alert. any quick pattern (route/model/tier)?
maya: mostly /v1/chat with fncall enabled. payload shapes vary; seq_len small.
olga: console shows a sharp cluster at 04:10. I can split strict vs soft in the panel.
rory: current telemetry emits `validation_reason: schema_mismatch` which is too coarse. need category (missing/ type/ array) + route_id.
liam: +1. also tag model_variant and customer_tier for filtering.
paul: add `fallback_reason` when fallback happens so we can attribute cost.
maya: proposal: emit `invoke.validation.v1` events with `category` [missing_field,type_mismatch,unexpected_array,extra_root], `mode` [strict,soft], `route_id`, `model`. sample payloads at 0.05% w/ per-route caps.
rory: will implement reservoir sampling per route and open PR with schema & tests.
olga: I'll add dashboard panels: category breakdown, route heatmap, and a cost-overlay. will also add an annotation for 04:00-04:30 UTC.
paul: change pager: only page on `mode=="strict"` or high-severity categories. soft rejects -> SLO burn only. update runbook accordingly.
liam: mitigation: temporarily bump degen routing threshold in eu-west 10%->20% for 30m while telemetry lands; keep premium canary unchanged.
maya: agreed. privacy: sampled payloads go to secure project, redaction pipeline, tag `sensitivity: pii_filtered`.
rory: PR: https://git.internal/r/telemetry/+/2401 (schema + unit tests).
olga: dashboard draft: https://console.internal/d/701/validation-errors. feedback welcome.
deploy-bot: deploy started: telemetry/agent v3.14 -> 04:45 UTC
maya: action items: rory PR, olga dashboard, paul alert+runbook, liam rollout throttle. will update when complete.
